    § 02 · The Method

    Designed to train, test, and transform.

    FLARE is built on the conviction that oil and gas fluency is a strategic capability — not a technical footnote. Every module pairs business-English precision with operational judgment, engineering literacy, and the professional clarity that defines premium energy leaders.

    01

    Premium Curriculum

    One hundred modules covering every domain of modern oil and gas — from the foundations of exploration and drilling to AI-powered energy systems and automated rigs.

    02

    Realistic Scenarios

    Every MCQ is rooted in plausible professional situations — well control events, refinery turnarounds, contract negotiations, emergency response — written for international oil and gas professionals.

    03

    Automatic Grading

    Instant scoring with tiered performance feedback — from foundational to executive fluency — plus the vocabulary and strategic insight earned from each module.

    04

    Progress That Tracks

    Your completion and scores are tracked live as you move through the program. Revisit your strongest topics anytime in this session, or retake a module to refine your fluency.

    § 03 · The Author

    Brice Gadou

    Business English Expert

    Brice Gadou is a Business English specialist dedicated to building world-class language training for international professionals. FLARE reflects his vision: oil and gas fluency as strategic capability — a multiplier of trust, clarity, and operational credibility.

    Designed for the petroleum engineers, site leads, and operations leaders shaping how the world's energy is responsibly produced — FLARE is more than vocabulary. It's the fluency to communicate in the discipline most responsible for turning a well into genuine value.
